source: Dancsok2019 mainmethodspp1773–1774,suppTable1 andFigS1 caption; Dancsok2020 verifiedR1 extraction

Dancsok2019.material: FFPE surgical specimens, UBC/Vancouver/MountSinai and Norwegian GIST tissue microarrays
Dancsok2019.technical_replicates: Duplicate/triplicate source TMAs; replicate cores scored separately, blinded to replicates and final diagnosis; mean all replicates, not independent donors
Dancsok2019.count_units: Positive-staining lymphocytes counted percore and divided by respective core area; cells/mm² of tissue. H&E TIL counted morphologically, independently of marker-positive subsets. No normalisation to viable tumour-cell number supplied.

CD8.identity: positive-staining lymphocytes by pathologist morphology; serial IHC sections

Dancsok2019.CD3: Not in source assayed panel; cannot relabel H&E TIL as CD3 or CD8
Dancsok2019.CD68_CD163: Not assayed in this earlier T-cell source
Dancsok2019.preservation: FFPE; all blocks batchcut within6months; Vancouver stained within7days, MountSinai cut immediately before shipping; different core diameters normalised by area
Dancsok2019.condition_metadata: Clinical subset with grade/therapy/outcomes only; main body660 vsTable2heading665 discrepancy retained. No authenticated EMC donor/site/grade/therapy/NR4A3 map.
Dancsok2019.spatial_identity: No co-registration or mutually-exclusive CD68/CD163/CD8 populations established; marker-density ratio is operational index, not verified cell fraction
Dancsok2019.supplement: 6pages; S1 antibody details,S2 non-sarcoma roster,S3 pooled grade/neoadjuvant/molecular-driver models; figure captions checked, images/plots not inspected
Dancsok2019.CD4_detail_discrepancy: TableS1 lists SP35, FigS1caption says4B12; not used to infer a CD8/CD3/EMC result

Dancsok2020_reuse.source: R1 microenvironment validated cohort/extracted supplement; no new download or arithmetic
Dancsok2020_reuse.published_aggregate_scope: CD68 median0cells/mm²(n5),CD163median5(n5),adjusted meanCD68:TILratio0.3(n4); prior art, not reconstructed individual counts
Dancsok2020_reuse.ratio_method: Published FigS1caption adjusts every value by+1. Cannot recalculate a no-pseudocount CD68:CD3/CD8 ratio from aggregate plot or unmatched donor values.
Dancsok2020_reuse.technical_replicates: Duplicatecores averaged, macrophages/mm²; no percase crosswalk
Dancsok2020_reuse.overlap: Same investigator/biobank source context supports overlap caution, not evidence that all2020matchedTIL EMC donors are identifiable among2019reported1072. No independent replication assumed.

alternatives: Near-zero T-cell denominator inflates a relative index without substantial macrophage density.
CD68 andCD163 can overlap; neither their sum nor a marker-density ratio proves a mutually-exclusive cell fraction.
Morphological H&E TIL includes lymphocyte subsets and is not a CD3/CD8-specific denominator.
Myxoid lowcellularity, corearea/ROI selection, site/grade/previousRT/chemotherapy and surgical vs metastatic biopsy can explain differences.
Separate serial sections/unequal core evaluability and reused donors prevent fabricated paired ratios or independent precision.
